name: Male Leadership
overview: Scripture establishes male leadership as part of God's created order, beginning with the man being formed first and the woman as a suitable helper (Genesis 2:18). After the fall, the woman’s desire is directed toward her husband, who is given the role to rule over her (Genesis 3:16). This leadership is characterized by loving sacrifice, as husbands are called to love their wives as Christ loved the church (Ephesians 5:25), while mutual submission is encouraged within the fear of God (Ephesians 5:21). Furthermore, church leadership is entrusted to qualified men who hold firmly to sound doctrine and are able to teach and correct (Titus 1:5, 9).
